_: Delhi's year-by-year particulate concentrations as the Commission for Air Quality Management states them. OFFICIAL DATA, committed by hand: a government release, not a reading this site takes, and not re-derivable from this site's own record, which begins 25 August 2026. The release calls each figure the 'daily avg.' for the year, to 31 December; it does not say which monitors were averaged or how missing days were treated, so this series is compared only with itself and with the annual standard, never with this page's hourly worst-monitor reading.
